reviewer_instructions: Open each source JPEG from archived GitHub branch and visually inspect the actual material; every positive claim must cite its specific canvas OID and normalized coordinate polygon/rectangle plus date/view.
The source JPEG hash was verified as archived data in CI, but this does not prove original physical collation or manuscript date.
Distinguish 'visible photographic observation', 'second-hand codicological expert description', 'physical inference', and 'untested conjecture' with separate provenance.
Physical foldout/photo boundaries do not map automatically to transcription panel IDs; draw and verify individual panel guides before assigning the orientation.
For contradictory claims (e.g., q9 old sewing holes versus preparatory cuts, q14 adhesive strips) keep both as alternatives until directly adjudicated.

Independent Keeper may check completeness and contradictory evidence but may not silently turn missing observations into PASS. Freeze only independently verified hard edges; historical O2 remains UNKNOWN otherwise.
Do not inspect any lexical/TF-IDF/LSA experiments while judging these physical hypotheses.
